init_SawyerDoorLockEnvV2: create a SawyerDoorLockEnvV2 instance to initialize the door lock environment with hand and object bounds
evaluate_state: evaluate the current observation and action to compute reward and success info for the door lock task
compute_reward: compute the shaped reward signal based on tcp proximity to lock and lock press distance
reset_model: reset the door lock environment model to initial or random door position and return observation
get_quat_objects: get the current quaternion orientation of the door link body in the simulation
